profile.ja: 対魔忍の一人。戦闘能力はアサギに次ぐと目されているクール美女。アサギが頭領を務める一派の下忍の出。兄は同じく対魔忍の八津九郎。政府によって設立された対魔忍養成学校・五車学園で教師も務める。得物の大斧を軽々と操る。ポストアサギ、次代の対魔忍隊長と将来を嘱望されている。アサギに憧れ以上の強い感情を抱いており、クールな彼女もアサギの前ではシドロモドロになる。子供の頃の将来の夢はアサギお姉さまの妹になること。本当に妹であるさくらに対して強いコンプレックスを持っていて、何かときつく当たっている。理解されにくいが本当は優しい性格。ネコ好きだがネコに怖がられるのが悩み。ある任務で魔科医・桐生と死闘の末に桐生を捕虜にする。
profile.en: (Yatsu Murasaki, she/her) Yatsu Murasaki is a Taimanin whose combat prowess is considered second only to Asagi's, making her a cool-beauty on the battlefield. She is a junior ninja under the faction led by Asagi, and her brother is the fellow Taimanin Yatsu Kuro. She also teaches at Gosha Academy, the government-run Taimanin training school, and wields a massive axe with ease. Seen as Asagi's successor, she is expected to become the next Taimanin commander. She harbors feelings for Asagi that surpass mere admiration, and even the usually cool-headed Asagi makes her flustered. As a child, she dreamed of becoming Asagi's little sister. She feels a deep complex toward her actual sister, Sakura, and often treats her harshly. Though hard to read, she is truly kind-hearted. She loves cats but worries that they're scared of her. During a mission she fought a demon scientist, Kiryu, and captured him as a prisoner.

text.ja: 「対魔忍、八津紫だ。これからよろしく頼む」
text.en: Taimanin Yatsu Murasaki, reporting. Let's get along.

text.ja: さて、何をするかさっさと決めろ。私の方はもう準備が出来ている
text.en: Alright, decide what we're doing, and make it fast. I'm ready.

text.ja: 貴様、まさかたるんでいるなどと言う事はないだろうな？　しっかりしろ！
text.en: You wouldn't be saying you're slacking, would you? Snap out of it!

text.ja: 最近下の者の指導も多く少し身体が鈍っているな……鍛錬でもするか
text.en: Lately I've been training the lower ranks a lot, and my body feels a bit dull… I should get some training in.

text.ja: なんだ？　あまりジロジロとこっちを見るな。別にやることがあるだろ
text.en: What? Stop staring at me. I have things to do, after all.

text.ja: ああ、アサギ様ぁ……♪　はっ！？　な、なんでもないぞ！　気のせいだ！
text.en: Ah, Asagi-sama…♪ Huh!? N-no, it's nothing! Just my imagination!

text.ja: アサギ様……あ、いや！　アサギ隊長の為、この八津紫、粉骨砕身努力してみせる！
text.en: Asagi-sama… ah, no! For Captain Asagi, I, Yatsu Murasaki, will push myself to the limit!

text.ja: 対魔忍八津紫推参！　大斧の餌食になりたい者からかかってこい！
text.en: Taimanin Yatsu Murasaki, stepping forward! Whoever wants to become the great axe's meal, bring it on!
